_about: The For you tab (/next/directory/#foryou, opened from the landing page): what the landing page's AI read in someone's words (topics, place, preferences, safety: build/tools/assist/tags.json) turned into picks and buttons by the rules here. No AI here. Read by build/next/js/for-you.js. topics: for each topic, its line, the service types that make a good first step, words in a name or description that make one better (prefer_words), the groups (who) it suits (groups_ok) and a short name for buttons. open_to_all: the who values that mean anyone can go: the picks only use services open to all (or to a group the topic suits, groups_ok), since we don't know who's asking. score: each candidate gets days until it next runs + miles x per_mile, plus a penalty for each way it fits less well; the lowest wins. help_types: the kinds of help someone can ask for, as the sheet's types. when_hours: what daytime and evenings mean (a session's start time) and which days are weekends. safety: the panel for each risk group (most serious first), its words and the services (sheet record ids) it shows, with more by topic or for under-18s; picks: whether the usual picks show beneath (none, or relevant: only their topics, nothing added). explore: the buttons beside the picks; kind_titles: a button's title for each kind of service.
